day_shape: 89 items: Jerusalem Post reports a draft US-Iran MoU awaiting Mojtaba Khamenei and Trump approval, IDF says it struck 135+ Hezbollah targets and hit Beirut for the first time in three weeks, CENTCOM reports an intercepted Iranian ballistic missile fired at Kuwait, and Khamenei's office issued a parliament-anniversary message cycle.

threads.label: US-Iran ceasefire and draft MoU
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported that a draft US-Iran memorandum of understanding is awaiting approval from Mojtaba Khamenei and Donald Trump, and that negotiators have agreed to extend the ceasefire pending Trump's sign-off. Iranian deputy foreign minister Gharibabadi told IRIB Iran would respond decisively to any ceasefire violation and would not sign any deal not aligned with national interests.

threads.label: IDF Lebanon offensive intensifies
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck over 135 Hezbollah targets in the past day, hit Beirut for the first time in three weeks targeting Ali al-Husni of the Imam Hossein Division, and confirmed raids beyond its forward defence line in southern Lebanon. IDF spokesman Brig. Gen. Effie Defrin said nearly a third of Hezbollah's pre-2023 force has been killed or wounded, including 2,500 fighters since March, and Avichay Adraee issued evacuation warnings for Tyre and six southern villages.

threads.label: Iranian missile and drone incidents
threads.summary: CENTCOM said Iran launched a ballistic missile at Kuwait at 10:17pm ET on 27 May that was intercepted by Kuwaiti forces, hours after five Iranian one-way attack drones near the Strait of Hormuz were intercepted by US forces. CENTCOM also said more than 20 US warships are enforcing a blockade against Iran, with 111 commercial vessels redirected to ensure compliance.

threads.label: Khamenei parliament-anniversary message
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a message from Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei marking the anniversary of the first Majles and the third year of the 12th parliament, calling for focus on the slogan 'resistance economy under national unity' and reconstruction from the 'second and third imposed wars'. The message thanked Speaker Qalibaf, urged MPs to avoid factional disputes, and was followed by a memorial for family members killed alongside the previous Supreme Leader.

threads.label: IRGC commemoration of Pakpour
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB covered the 40th-day commemoration of Lt. Gen. Mohammad Pakpour at Tehran's Payambar-e Azam mosque, with Rear Adm. Ali Fadavi saying the armed forces would respond decisively to any US attack and Tehran IRGC commander Hassan Hassanzadeh claiming the corps is focused on urban, defensive and hybrid warfare. A comrade of Pakpour quoted by Defa Press claimed IRGC sabotage units would destroy US forces on Gulf islands.

threads.label: Iranian war-cost and Trump narrative
threads.summary: IRIB amplified pieces from CNN, The Atlantic and The New Yorker claiming Iran is reactivating underground missile stockpiles, that Trump's Iran war has cost at least $28 billion and damaged the Republican Party, and that the Strait of Hormuz disruption has caused a global energy shock. IRIB also relayed Russian foreign ministry warnings of retaliation if 5,000 additional US troops deploy to Poland.

threads.label: Gaza and Israeli home-front tallies
threads.summary: Netanyahu said at the Jordan Valley Conference that Israel controls over half of Gaza and has ordered the seizure of more, while the IDF Home Front Command reported 6,473 Israeli homes destroyed and 24 killed during the Iran war. Gaza's health ministry said via IRIB that the Palestinian death toll since October 2023 has reached 72,819.

In southern Lebanon and the eastern Beqaa Valley, the IDF says that it struck 10 rocket launching sites, along with a Hezbollah training camp. The Israeli Air Force also struck and killed several Hezbollah operatives who were seen leaving a rocket-launching site used in an attack on troops, the IDF adds.
